title.zh: 桥：两个 plan 共用的论文

lead.en: Papers that Plan A and Plan B both depend on.
lead.zh: Plan A 和 Plan B 都要用到的论文。

nodes.label: Kidney atlas (Lake 2023)
nodes.title: An atlas of healthy and injured cell states and niches in the human kidney

oneliner.en: A KPMP / HuBMAP / HCA multimodal single-cell + spatial atlas of the human kidney: >400,000 cells/nuclei (snRNA, scRNA, SNARE-seq2 dual-omics) plus Slide-seq2, Visium and large-scale 3D imaging, spanning 45 healthy reference donors and 48 AKI/CKD patients; it defines 51 main cell types and 28 injury-associated "altered states" (cycling, adaptive/maladaptive repair, transitioning, degenerative), localizes them to injury niches, and shows that TAL/PT adaptive-repair signatures predict decline of kidney function.
oneliner.zh: KPMP / HuBMAP / HCA 联合构建的人肾多模态单细胞 + 空间图谱:> 40 万个细胞/细胞核(snRNA、scRNA、SNARE-seq2 双组学),配合 Slide-seq2、Visium 与大规模 3D 成像,覆盖 45 名健康参照供体与 48 名 AKI/CKD 患者,定义 51 种主要细胞类型和 28 种损伤相关的"altered states"(cycling、adaptive/maladaptive repair、transitioning、degenerative),把它们定位到损伤 niche,并发现 TAL/PT 的 adaptive 修复签名可预测肾功能下降。

nodes.label: Inflammatory PT cells
nodes.title: Multiomic analysis of human kidney disease identifies a tractable inflammatory and pro-fibrotic tubular cell phenotype

oneliner.en: Combining snRNA+snATAC multiome with CosMx high-plex single-cell spatial imaging (6,000- and 1,000-plex), the authors identify a VCAM1+ICAM1+ inflammatory proximal-tubule (PT) cell in human kidney disease: a subset of KPMP "adaptive PT" cells that expresses chemokines, pro-fibrotic and senescence-associated genes and localizes specifically to the fibrotic niche; it is epigenetically imprinted by HNF4α-network collapse plus AP-1/NF-κB activation; in mice the AP-1 inhibitor T5224 or the senolytic ABT-263 depletes these cells and reduces inflammation and fibrosis.
oneliner.zh: 作者把 snRNA+snATAC 多组学与 CosMx 高通量单细胞空间成像(6,000 与 1,000 探针)结合,在人类肾病中找到一类 VCAM1+ICAM1+ 炎症性近端小管(PT)细胞:它们是 KPMP「adaptive PT」的一个亚群,表达趋化因子、促纤维化与衰老相关基因,特异地定位在纤维化 niche;表观上由 HNF4α 网络崩溃 + AP-1/NF-κB 激活锁定;在小鼠中用 AP-1 抑制剂 T5224 或衰老清除剂 ABT-263 能减少这类细胞并减轻炎症和纤维化。

nodes.label: ResolVI
nodes.title: ResolVI: addressing noise and bias in spatial transcriptomics

oneliner.en: resolVI is a VAE-based generative model in scvi-tools that sits downstream of any segmentation algorithm and decomposes each cell's observed counts into three parts — the cell's true expression, expression "diffused" in from neighbouring cells, and a per-slice constant non-specific background — removing spurious co-expression caused by molecule misassignment while producing a batch-corrected probabilistic latent representation that supports differential expression and differential niche-abundance testing.
oneliner.zh: resolVI 是 scvi-tools 里的一个 VAE 生成模型,接在任意分割算法之后,把每个细胞的观测计数拆成三部分 —— 细胞自身的真实表达、从邻近细胞「扩散」进来的表达、以及每张切片恒定的非特异背景 —— 从而去除分子错配导致的虚假共表达,同时给出批次校正后的概率潜在表示,支持差异表达和空间邻域丰度检验。

nodes.label: Conformal annotation
nodes.title: Conformal inference for reliable single cell RNA-seq annotation

oneliner.en: Adds distribution-free statistical guarantees to automatic scRNA-seq annotation with conformal prediction: an autoencoder + conformal p-values first detects cell types absent from the reference (OOD) with false-positive rate ≤ α₀; the remaining cells get prediction sets with coverage guarantees (standard / classwise / cluster Mondrian taxonomies; APS / RAPS / THR non-conformity scores), where set size is the uncertainty. Departures of the conformal p-values from uniformity also diagnose broken reference–query exchangeability.
oneliner.zh: 用 conformal prediction 给 scRNA-seq 自动注释加上分布无关的统计保证:先用自编码器 + conformal p 值检测参照中不存在的细胞类型(OOD),控制假阳性率 ≤ α₀;再对剩下的细胞输出带覆盖保证的预测集合(标准 / classwise / cluster 三种 Mondrian 分类方式,APS / RAPS / THR 三种非一致性分数),集合大小即不确定性;conformal p 值分布偏离均匀还可以用来诊断参照与 query 之间的可交换性是否被破坏。

nodes.label: SpatialAgent
nodes.title: SpatialAgent: An autonomous AI agent for spatial biology

oneliner.en: SpatialAgent is the Genentech/Regev-lab agent specialised for spatial omics: a Plan-Act-Conclude architecture with dynamic retrieval over 72 tools / 17 reusable skills, image interpretation, and reporting and verification subagents that audit numerical and visual claims, covering gene-panel design, cell/niche annotation, trajectories, cell–cell communication, imputation and hypothesis generation. It beats established methods and matches or exceeds experts on DLPFC panel design and fetal-heart MERFISH annotation, and designed a 100-gene add-on panel used in a prospective mouse prostate-cancer Xenium study (4.2M cells, 21 samples).
oneliner.zh: SpatialAgent 是 Genentech/Regev 组面向空间组学的专用 agent:Plan-Act-Conclude 架构 + 72 个工具 / 17 个可复用 skill 的动态检索 + 图像解读 + 报告与验证子 agent(逐条审计数值与视觉声明),覆盖基因 panel 设计、细胞/niche 注释、轨迹、细胞通讯、插补与假设生成;在 DLPFC panel 设计、胎儿心脏 MERFISH 注释上胜过既有方法并与专家持平或更优,并在前瞻性小鼠前列腺癌 Xenium 实验中设计了 100 基因附加 panel(实测 4.2M 细胞、21 个样本)。

nodes.label: BioML-bench
nodes.title: BioML-bench: Evaluation of AI Agents for End-to-End Biomedical ML

oneliner.en: BioML-bench ports MLE-bench's "task capsule + automatic grading" paradigm to biomedicine: 24 end-to-end ML tasks (drug discovery, biomedical imaging, protein engineering, single-cell) where the agent builds the pipeline, trains models and submits predictions, scored as percentiles on largely expert-populated public leaderboards. Four agents (Biomni, STELLA, AIDE, MLAgentBench) average only the 34th–39th percentile, and biomedical specialization confers no consistent advantage.
oneliner.zh: BioML-bench 把 MLE-bench 的「任务 capsule + 自动评分」范式搬到生物医学:24 个端到端 ML 任务(药物发现、医学影像、蛋白工程、单细胞),agent 需自己建 pipeline、训模型、提交预测,再映射到以领域专家为主的公开排行榜百分位。四个 agent(Biomni、STELLA、AIDE、MLAgentBench)平均只到 34–39 百分位,且生物医学专用 agent 并无一致优势。

label.zh: 损伤 / 修复失败状态

definition.en: A technical artifact where two cells or nuclei are captured under one barcode and analysed as a single cell, producing a chimeric expression profile that can masquerade as a novel cell state.
definition.zh: 两个细胞或细胞核被同一条形码捕获、当作一个细胞分析的技术假象,产生嵌合表达谱,可能被误认为一种新的细胞状态。

definition.en: The image-analysis step of delineating individual cell boundaries so that molecular signals can be assigned to single cells.
definition.zh: 在图像分析中勾勒单个细胞边界的步骤,以便将分子信号归属到单个细胞。

definition.en: Systematic non-biological variation between datasets acquired at different sites, times, or platforms that can confound analysis if not corrected.
definition.zh: 不同机构、时间或平台采集的数据集之间的系统性非生物学差异,若不校正会混淆分析。

label.zh: 分布外 / 新颖性检测

definition.en: Flagging inputs that fall outside the data distribution a model was trained on, such as an unseen drug, cell context, or diseased tissue.
definition.zh: 标记落在模型训练分布之外的输入,如未见过的药物、细胞语境或病变组织。

definition.en: A 10x Genomics imaging-based platform that measures a targeted panel of transcripts in situ at subcellular resolution with single-cell segmentation.
definition.zh: 一种基于成像的 10x Genomics 平台,在亚细胞分辨率下原位测量目标转录本组合,并进行单细胞分割。
